pm_exper_user_1572_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some good ways to stay updated on what's happening in my community without relying on national news sources?
pm_exper_user_1572_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could subscribe to a few outdoor adventure blogs, follow local hiking groups on Instagram, and keep an eye on Tennessee state park updates for what’s happening near you. Community bulletin boards at outdoor gear shops can also give you the scoop on events and meetups. That way, you’ll know what’s going on in your area without combing through unrelated national headlines.
(b) You could follow your city’s main local news outlets, tune into a local radio station, and join neighborhood-specific online groups to keep up with nearby developments. Checking community bulletin boards—both online and at public spaces—can help you catch smaller happenings too. It’s an easy way to stay informed without relying on national sources.
(c) You could follow Nashville Scene, AP News Nashville, and WPLN for quick local updates, and pair that with neighborhood Facebook groups or East Nashville-focused Instagram accounts. Checking event boards at your favorite venues is also handy—sometimes you’ll catch community happenings that don’t make it into bigger outlets. It’s a great way to stay plugged into the city’s vibe without the noise of national coverage.
(d) You could follow local music blogs like Nashville Scene’s music section, tune into Lightning 100 for scene updates, and keep an eye on Instagram accounts that track East Nashville gigs. Venue bulletin boards are also gold mines for spotting last-minute shows and pop-ups. That way you can stay connected to the heartbeat of Nashville without wading through national news.
